```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from datetime import date
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
while not (root / "curriculum.yaml").is_file() and root != root.parent:
    root = root.parent
status = json.loads((root / "progress" / "status.json").read_text("utf-8"))

LEARN = ["Mastered", "Reviewed", "Practicing", "Reading", "Not Started"]
ACTIVE = ("Reading", "Practicing")
chapters = status["chapters"]
totals = status["totals"]
slug = lambda s: s.lower().replace(" ", "-")


def chapter_link(ch):
    label = f"{ch['id']} {ch['title_zh']}"
    return f"[{label}]({ch['note']})" if ch["note_exists"] else label


def tile(value, label):
    return f'<div class="dash-tile"><div class="dash-value">{value}</div><div class="dash-label">{label}</div></div>'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 概览
in_progress = sum(totals["learn"][s] for s in ACTIVE)
last = status.get("last_test")
if last:
    s = last["summary"]
    ran = s.get("passed", 0) + s.get("failed", 0)
    test_value = f'{s.get("passed", 0)}/{ran}'
else:
    test_value = "—"

print('<div class="dash-grid">')
print(tile(f'{totals["built"]}/{totals["chapters"]}', "已建设章节"))
print(tile(in_progress, "正在学习"))
print(tile(totals["learn"]["Reviewed"] + totals["learn"]["Mastered"], "Reviewed / Mastered"))
print(tile(len(status["open_annotations"]), "未解决的疑问与勘误"))
print(tile(test_value, "最近一次练习测试通过"))
print("</div>\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 当前阶段
print("## 当前阶段\n")
roadmap = root / "ROADMAP.md"
if roadmap.is_file():
    print("个人化路线见 [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md)。\n")
else:
    print(
        "**阶段 0：仓库初始化与诊断（第 1–2 周）。** 仓库骨架与试点章节 M04.2 已就绪。"
        "下一步是 Phase 1b：为 Module 01–05 做诊断测评，据此生成个人化的 `ROADMAP.md`。"
        "默认的 12 个月计划见 [Path B](learning-paths/path-b-ai-for-science.md)。\n"
    )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 接下来的章节
print("## 接下来的章节\n")
queue = [c for c in chapters if c["learn_status"] in ACTIVE]
queue += [c for c in chapters if c["note_exists"] and c["learn_status"] == "Not Started"]
if queue:
    print("| 章节 | 优先级 | 学习状态 | 建设状态 |")
    print("|---|---|---|---|")
    for ch in queue[:3]:
        print(f"| {chapter_link(ch)} | {ch['priority']} | {ch['learn_status']} | {ch['build_status']} |")
    print()
    if len(queue) < 3:
        print("讲义按即时建设原则创建，最多领先学习进度两章。需要新章节时，让 Agent 以 BUILD 模式建设。\n")
else:
    print("没有已建设且未学完的章节。让 Agent 以 BUILD 模式建设 `ROADMAP.md` 中的下一章。\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 模块进度
print("## 模块进度\n")
print('<div class="dash-modules">')
for m in status["modules"]:
    n = m["chapters"]
    segs = []
    for state in LEARN:
        count = m["learn"][state]
        if state == "Not Started":
            count = m["built"] - sum(m["learn"][s] for s in LEARN[:-1])
        if count > 0:
            segs.append(f'<span class="dash-seg-{slug(state)}" style="flex:{count}" title="{state}: {count}"></span>')
    unbuilt = n - m["built"]
    if unbuilt > 0:
        segs.append(f'<span class="dash-seg-unbuilt" style="flex:{unbuilt}" title="尚未建设: {unbuilt}"></span>')
    done = m["learn"]["Reviewed"] + m["learn"]["Mastered"]
    print(
        f'<div class="dash-row"><div class="dash-name"><a href="{m["dir"]}/README.html">'
        f'{m["id"][1:]} {escape(m["title_zh"])}</a></div>'
        f'<div class="dash-bar">{"".join(segs)}</div>'
        f'<div class="dash-count">{done}/{n} 完成 · {m["built"]} 已建</div></div>'
    )
print("</div>")
legend = [("mastered", "Mastered"), ("reviewed", "Reviewed"), ("practicing", "Practicing"),
          ("reading", "Reading"), ("not-started", "已建设、未开始"), ("unbuilt", "尚未建设")]
print('<div class="dash-legend">' + "".join(
    f'<span><i class="dash-seg-{k}"></i>{v}</span>' for k, v in legend) + "</div>\n")
print("每章的状态明细见[课程总目录](CURRICULUM.md)。\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 疑问与勘误
print("## 未解决的疑问与勘误\n")
KIND = {"question": "疑问", "bug": "勘误"}
if status["open_annotations"]:
    for a in status["open_annotations"]:
        where = a["chapter"] or a["file"]
        excerpt = f"：{a['excerpt']}" if a["excerpt"] else ""
        print(f"- **{KIND.get(a['kind'], a['kind'])}** · {where} · [{a['title']}]({a['file']}#{a['anchor']}){excerpt}")
    print("\n让 Agent 以 TUTOR 模式（疑问）或 VERIFY 模式（勘误）处理；确认解决后把 `.anno-open` 改为 `.anno-resolved`。\n")
else:
    print("目前没有。阅读讲义时用代码片段 `aq`（疑问）或 `ab`（勘误）在原处插入批注，它们会汇总到这里。\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 到期复测
print("## 到期复测\n")
today = date.today().isoformat()
due = sorted((c for c in chapters if c["next_review"] and c["next_review"] <= today),
             key=lambda c: c["next_review"])
upcoming = sorted((c for c in chapters if c["next_review"] and c["next_review"] > today),
                  key=lambda c: c["next_review"])
if due:
    for ch in due:
        print(f"- {chapter_link(ch)}：应于 {ch['next_review']} 复测")
    print()
elif upcoming:
    ch = upcoming[0]
    print(f"今天没有到期的复测。最近一次：{chapter_link(ch)}，{ch['next_review']}。\n")
else:
    print("还没有安排复测。章节达到 `Mastered` 后，在讲义 frontmatter 的 `next_review` 填写日期（约 1 个月和 3 个月后各一次）。\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 测试结果
print("## 最近一次练习测试\n")
if last:
    s = last["summary"]
    when = (last.get("timestamp") or "")[:16].replace("T", " ")
    scope = " ".join(last.get("args") or [])
    print(f"{when} · 目标 `{last.get('target')}` · `{scope}`\n")
    print(f"通过 **{s.get('passed', 0)}**，失败 **{s.get('failed', 0)}**，跳过 {s.get('skipped', 0)}。\n")
    if last.get("failed"):
        print("尚未通过的测试：\n")
        for nodeid in last["failed"][:12]:
            print(f"- `{nodeid.split('::', 1)[-1]}`（{Path(nodeid.split('::')[0]).name}）")
        if len(last["failed"]) > 12:
            print(f"- ……其余 {len(last['failed']) - 12} 条见 `progress/test-results.json`")
        print()
else:
    print("还没有记录。运行 `make ex M=04` 后，结果会显示在这里。\n")
```

## 怎么用这个仓库

阅读在浏览器里的学习网站完成，批注、练习和测试在 VS Code 里完成，两者读写的是同一份源文件。

1. `make preview` 启动本地网站，保存源文件后页面自动刷新；
2. 读讲义时点击页面顶部的“在 VS Code 中编辑”，用代码片段插入批注；
3. 从讲义的“代码导航”跳到练习，实现后用 `make ex M=04` 或测试面板检查；
4. 用 `make status ID=M04.2 S=Practicing` 更新学习状态，本页随之更新；
5. 让 Agent 处理未解决的疑问，或建设下一章。

完整说明见[快速开始](docs/getting-started.md)和[学习指南](docs/learning-guide.md)。
